standard.label: Quick single pass
standard.description: Translates each page once using only brief recent context. This is the fastest option.

cumulative.label: Cumulative context (Recommended)
cumulative.description: Builds page summaries, terms, and character memory while translating, then uses them from the next page onward.

twoPass.label: Precision two-pass
twoPass.description: Analyzes the selected context after the first pass, then translates again. This is the slowest but highest-quality option.

translationOptions.secondPassHint: After the first pass, AI analyzes terminology, characters, and context, then translates again using that analysis. This takes longer because the selected pages are translated twice.
translationOptions.keepBlocksHint: Pages with blocks keep their regions and formatting while only the text is replaced. Blocks are generated automatically on pages without them.

limits.title: Generation limits
limits.publicContextOnly: Published model context: {{contextWindow}} · maximum output is not published
limits.unknownLimits: No published model limits are available, so a safe shared recommendation is used.

maxTokens.label: Maximum output tokens
maxTokens.remoteDescription: Caps the full response, including visible text and reasoning. The task recommendation is safer than using the model ceiling.
maxTokens.gemmaDescription: Caps what the local model can generate in one response. Higher values can increase processing time and memory use.

contextTokens.remoteDescription: This is an app budget for work memory, glossary, and character notes—not the model's server-side context window.
contextTokens.gemmaDescription: The actual context length for local Gemma. Higher values can use more VRAM.

minimum12b.label: 12B minimum
minimum12b.description: For about 8 GB of VRAM. Prioritizes compatibility and light operation.

economy26b.label: 26B economy
economy26b.description: For about 16 GB of VRAM. Keeps 1024 image tokens and runs the 26B model more safely.

full31b.label: 31B full
full31b.description: For ample VRAM. Uses the 31B model and DFlash with quality as the priority.

huggingface.label: Hugging Face
huggingface.description: Download the model automatically from a Hugging Face repository.

local.label: Local files
local.description: Use GGUF and mmproj files you provide.

gemma.label: Local Gemma
gemma.description: Run a Gemma model directly on this PC.

codex.label: Codex
codex.description: Translate through a Codex OAuth endpoint.

high.label: High
high.description: Uses more reasoning for better quality.

xhigh.label: Very high
xhigh.description: Uses extra reasoning for complex translations.

max.label: Maximum
max.description: Uses the highest standard reasoning level supported by the model.

ultra.label: Ultra
ultra.description: Requests the model's highest supported reasoning level.

cuda.label: NVIDIA CUDA
cuda.description: Run Paddle OCR on an NVIDIA GPU.

rocm.label: AMD ROCm
rocm.description: Use the experimental OCR engine for AMD GPUs.

cpu.label: CPU
cpu.description: Run OCR on the CPU without a GPU.

metal.label: Apple Metal
metal.description: Metal llama.cpp runtime for Apple Silicon.

rtx50.label: RTX 50
rtx50.description: CUDA runtime tuned for RTX 50-series GPUs.

metal.label: Apple Metal
metal.description: Required native Metal runtime for Flux Klein on Apple Silicon.

cuda.label: NVIDIA CUDA
cuda.description: The fastest native Flux runtime on RTX GPUs.

zluda.label: AMD ZLUDA
zluda.description: Runs Flux through ZLUDA on AMD GPUs. Requires the AMD HIP SDK.

cpu.label: CPU
cpu.description: A slow CPU compatibility mode for systems without a matching GPU runtime.

aot.label: AOT minimum
aot.description: The lightest Koharu AOT inpainting model.

lama.label: LaMa economy
lama.description: A lightweight, fast LaMa model specialized for manga.

flux.label: Flux full
flux.description: The default quality-first Flux inpainting model.

translation.title: Translation languages
